kds_archive_undo.user_impact: Owner-described scenario: chef bumps order N°45 PREPARING -> PREPARED by mistake at rush hour (immediate PATCH, no toast, no undo window). The order disappears from active grid (Wave U partition - PREPARED leaves FIFO grid - KdsV2Grid.vue:48-52, 197-202). It surfaces in 'Recemment servies' bottom strip with 'il y a Xm' for ~4 orders, but no action available there either. Drawer 'Historique du jour' lists the order but has no revert control. Net: chef MUST tell cashier orally to recreate the order or manually intervene. Tracking is lost because OrderStateMachine recordTransition (line 132-150) wrote the forward transition irreversibly to order_status_transitions table.
kds_archive_undo.compound_severity: HIGH - this gap is amplified by Wave V's removal of the 3s undo window. Pre-Wave-V the chef had 3s grace; post-Wave-V the only safety net is the kitchen-cashier verbal channel (no UI surface).
kds_archive_undo.frozen_zone_constraint: OrderStateMachine §7 (CLAUDE.md frozen list) blocks adding reverse transitions WITHOUT a LOCK plan + owner countersign. NF525 audit chain is forward-append-only by design.

implementation_proposal.approach: Compensating-action pattern (NOT reverse transition - preserves NF525 forward-only invariant)
steps: 1. New backend endpoint POST /api/admin/kds-order/{order}/recall-recent (audit-logged, role: Chef/Branch Manager/Admin)
2. Eligibility window: 60s grace post PREPARING->PREPARED transition (mirrors existing kds.recallItem in resources/js/store/modules/kds.js:66-72 grace_expired pattern, server-validated)

3. Action mechanic: NOT a reverse transition. Instead, emit a 'kitchen_recall' OrderStatusTransition row (new transition_type column or reason field) that flags the order as 'recalled to kitchen' WITHOUT mutating order.status. UI surfaces this with a yellow 'RAPPELE' badge in the active grid (re-injecting the card visually).

4. Alternative if owner accepts surgical state-machine extension: add PREPARED->PREPARING to OrderStateMachine::allows() gated by user->hasPermissionTo('kds-recall') AND a 60s server-side recency check on updated_at. Requires LOCK_KDS_RECALL_2026-05-25.md per CLAUDE.md §7 procedure.
5. UI surface: add 'Annuler bump' button on the LAST bumped card in 'Recemment servies' strip (KdsV2Grid.vue:96-104), enabled only while within the 60s grace window with a visible countdown.
6. Audit: append-only OrderStatusTransition row with reason='kitchen_recall_within_grace'. NF525 audit chain semantics preserved.
implementation_proposal.estimated_complexity: Path 3 (compensating-action): MEDIUM - 2 backend endpoints + 1 migration + UI surface, no frozen-zone touch. Path 4 (state-machine extension): HIGH - frozen-zone LOCK + owner countersign + invariant impact analysis on KitchenReleaseRule + DispatchKdsTicket listener + 6-year audit retention semantics.
implementation_proposal.owner_decision_required: Choose between (a) compensating-action with badge + audit (path 3, no frozen touch) OR (b) gated reverse transition via LOCK (path 4).

verdict: OWNER MANDATE GAP CONFIRMED at maximum evidence level. KDS Archive undo is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT in V1 production by explicit design decision (Wave X3 2026-05-21 + Wave V 2026-05-21 + OrderStateMachine §7 frozen-zone). The chef has ZERO undo capability on V2 default layout - the 3s toast existed pre-Wave-V but was removed per owner mandate 'enleve cette securite' to fix a chained-bump race, leaving the chef with NO safety net at all. 13 additional gaps identified spanning chef-rush ergonomics (bump partiel, mass-bump, priorisation, parking-lot status), chef-cashier communication (signal OOS, cancel propagation), and observability (history annulations, TTS, reprint). Top 3 BLOCKER-DAILY are owner-mandated undo + per-item bump + chef->cashier OOS signaling. The implementation path forward for the owner mandate is compensating-action (no frozen-zone touch, NF525-tractable) OR gated reverse transition via LOCK_KDS_RECALL plan (frozen-zone touch + owner countersign per CLAUDE.md §7 procedure).
